provenance: Static repository structure and explicit import/reference relationships.
authorization: Discovery only; graph edges grant no tool or write authority.

nodes.label: source.contract-ingestion
nodes.summary: Version and required capabilities are configuration, not application constants.

nodes.label: source.verified-change-set
nodes.summary: Captures a complete local-Git base and candidate input tree from actual repository bytes under a pinned policy and producer implementation. The caller cannot supply changed paths or narrow the tracked plus nonignored-untracked scope; unsafe, secret, sparse, special-mode, ambiguous or concurrently changing inputs fail closed. A separately pinned host pipeline composes and current-verifies this stage without accepting caller scope, without exposing full artifacts, and without promoting partial results. This R0.4a artifact remains ANALYSIS_ONLY and is not a verified build or deployment receipt.

nodes.label: source.tree-graph-production
nodes.summary: Replays exact verified local-Git base and candidate manifests, performs bounded no-follow candidate reads, independently requires exactly one portable sfdx-project.json at any depth per side, resolves package roots relative to that descriptor, accounts for every file, and deterministically emits provenance-bound file plus supported-family Salesforce semantic nodes and edges. Ambiguous descriptors, aliases, unsafe or overlapping roots and unsupported package source families fail closed. Byte provenance and semantic identity are separate; node/edge deltas and tombstones are independently recomputed without caller paths, adapters, exclusions, graphs or seeds. A separately pinned host pipeline enforces exact stage receipts, permanent gaps, sanitized failures and current replay before returning a bounded projection. Developer indexes are never evidence authority. This supports one DX descriptor, not automatic selection among multiple projects. Incomplete source-family and downstream seed coverage remain explicit blocking gaps, so outputs stay ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible.

nodes.label: source.change-seed-mapping
nodes.summary: R0.4b preserves the earlier current-replayed path foundation. R0.4d separately replays the exact R0.4c product graph and R0.4a change set, accounts for every ADD, DELETE and MODIFY, preserves base/candidate semantic versions as side-qualified evidence, requires delete tombstones, accounts for nonsemantic files explicitly and partitions every graph delta without caller mappings, seeds or subsets. A separately pinned zero-scope-argument host pipeline composes and current-verifies R0.4a/R0.4c/R0.4d, binds the unique candidate DX root to the configured app root, prevents downstream execution and artifact promotion after failure, and keeps execution status separate from invariant evidence incompleteness. A fresh empty-request-only POST returns its bounded projection without persistence or AssuranceRun contamination. The supported-family operation mapping is complete, while trusted side-specific path replay, complete Salesforce-family, live-org and release evidence remain explicit blocking gaps; outputs stay ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible.

nodes.label: assurance.candidate-comparison
nodes.summary: Replays both sides of the host-captured Git candidate through the same source-neutral assurance path, binds every component run to exact graph/seed identities, persists the complete bundle atomically and exposes only a bounded release-ineligible client view. The caller cannot supply paths, sides, graph fragments or verified-change authority. This is offline candidate evidence; it is not a build, live-org, deployment or release receipt.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-impact
nodes.summary: Operates on canonical typed nodes and relations without source vocabulary in core policy; direction-aware propagation, complete ordered path receipts and a separate risk policy remain A2.

nodes.label: reasoning.directional-propagation
nodes.summary: Uses source-neutral canonical relations and endpoint roles with explicit direction, depth, evidence-state and path-receipt policies; runtime workflow integration remains pending.

nodes.label: knowledge.evidence-graph
nodes.summary: Treats project-, snapshot-, ontology- and profile-bound normalized evidence as the authority substrate; missing record envelopes remain unverified while durable graph ports and complete path replay remain planned.

nodes.label: knowledge.trusted-edge-envelope
nodes.summary: Compiles and replays source-neutral canonical-edge artifact envelopes against externally pinned project/snapshot, raw and normalized graph, ontology/profile, parser registry/implementation, policy, evidence-state and freshness roots. Release-only gaps are isolated from analysis, all results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY with upstream capture unattested, and no receipt can authorize release.

nodes.label: knowledge.complete-path-replay
nodes.summary: Derives a source-neutral, non-caller-narrowable candidate scope from all graph nodes and every reachable material target under independently pinned path, propagation and R0.1 trust roots; exact current envelope union and ordered path equality are required. Results remain ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible with change-seed and upstream-capture gaps.

nodes.label: knowledge.canonical-ontology
nodes.summary: Deterministically normalizes the current source vocabulary into versioned canonical classes and preserves mapping/trust gaps. Completion requires upstream record envelopes and proof that trusted first-source behavior is preserved; propagation/risk remain separate A2 policy.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-context-compiler
nodes.summary: Compiles an analysis-only, project/snapshot-isolated context pack from replay-validated canonical structure under deterministic atomic count/character/byte budgets. Caller-supplied source fragments and semantic receipts remain non-authoritative candidates; governed resolution, seed-rationale receipts, provider token/time budgets, outcome memory and workflow consumption remain planned.

nodes.label: reasoning.hybrid-candidate-fusion
nodes.summary: Deterministically fuses request-, context-, channel- and freshness-bound exact, lexical, confirmed-graph and semantic candidate receipts under an independently pinned policy/evaluation contract. Outputs remain analysis-only candidates; protected deterministic tiers, conflicts, omissions, outages and upstream context gaps are explicit. Completion requires real channel adapters, trusted A3 verification receipts and an adjudicated hybrid-quality corpus.

nodes.label: reasoning.graph-grounded-agent
nodes.summary: Provides a provider-neutral proposal/verifier plus a separately typed replay-validating workflow consumer. The consumer binds the complete change request and graph identity, replays current governance, isolates specialist failures, and can only emit bounded analysis-only candidate/inferred advisory results. Completion requires a real structured-output provider adapter with hard cancellation, independently persisted capture/consumption receipts, retry-safe workflow/checkpoint integration and an adjudicated quality corpus.

nodes.label: reasoning.semantic-retrieval
nodes.summary: Provider-neutral embeddings and standard cosine ranking.

nodes.label: retrieval.chromadb
nodes.summary: Project- and snapshot-isolated persistent semantic index behind the existing retrieval port; PostgreSQL remains authoritative relational memory.

nodes.label: orchestration.multi-agent
nodes.summary: Typed deterministic stages share governed state, and an isolated policy-configured consumer deterministically merges multiple replay-verified specialist artifacts without mutating authoritative run state. Durable live-provider invocation, capture registry, checkpoint/CAS integration and event outbox remain planned.

nodes.label: observability.agent-trace
nodes.summary: Emits bounded typed stage events and deliverables using capability, evidence, artifact, policy and gap identifiers without persisting prompts, secrets or hidden reasoning.

nodes.label: ui.assurance-dashboard
nodes.summary: Projects typed assurance-run, local-candidate-foundation and durable live-campaign-status contracts without scenario literals, execution controls or client-side governance decisions. The live campaign client accepts only a bounded campaign identifier for read-only replay, runtime-decodes a closed 15-gate projection and cannot submit Salesforce scope, evidence or authority. It keeps locally valid receipts distinct from accepted gates and preserves incomplete, zero-accepted and release-ineligible interlocks. The foundation client sends no caller scope, bounds and runtime-decodes every response, replays canonical contract digests, rejects impossible stage chains, clears stale evidence and preserves analysis-only, incomplete and release-ineligible interlocks. The run view separately distinguishes source-confirmed, human-recorded, inferred, contradictory and unresolved evidence; selected validations from execution receipts; proposals from applied actions; recorded activity from live dependency availability; and current decisions from audit-only history. Product-owned live execution, ordered path receipts, A6 advisory payloads, accessibility receipts and runtime validation of the legacy assurance-run response remain planned.

nodes.label: quality.test-selection
nodes.summary: Selects graph-connected test kinds rather than named test cases.

nodes.label: automation.locator-healing
nodes.summary: Discovers generic locator candidates from metadata identity and accessibility semantics and abstains on ambiguity. This library does not authorize or apply a browser mutation and cannot claim an executed heal.

nodes.label: governance.claim-grounding
nodes.summary: Validates evidence identifiers independently of business domain.

nodes.label: governance.release-decision
nodes.summary: Deterministic policy consumes typed risk and validation state, but a non-bypassable evidence-model interlock currently limits every release posture to INCOMPLETE.

nodes.label: governance.release-input-integrity
nodes.summary: A pinned R0.3 candidate-composition foundation binds the complete v2 run/request candidate surface, candidate change/build bytes, current-replayed R0.2/R0.1 path roots, deterministically replayed risk per stable structural path, advisory downstream payloads and current runtime policy identities into a canonical expiring manifest. It remains ANALYSIS_ONLY and release-ineligible because producer-derived change/build, risk factors, obligation/execution, conflict, approval and upstream capture completeness are not yet available; the non-bypassable INCOMPLETE interlock and historical-decision revalidation remain unchanged.

nodes.label: governance.measurement-contract
nodes.summary: Defines executable run-level metric populations, thresholds, applicability and typed guardrail outcomes without treating heuristic scores as calibrated probability.

nodes.label: memory.postgresql
nodes.summary: Primary non-vector relational memory uses a dedicated validated Neo schema and ownership marker. Run documents, atomic candidate bundles, LangGraph checkpoints, append-only outcome candidates and exact-byte live receipt records have adapter foundations. Live target-runtime save/resume/concurrency plus governed graph, audit, approval and evaluation application ports remain unaccepted.

nodes.label: memory.resilient-fallback
nodes.summary: Run storage falls back from PostgreSQL to auto-created SQLite/process memory; outcome storage independently falls back through auto-created SQLite, immutable JSON and process cache. The live-receipt reader uses PostgreSQL or auto-created SQLite and becomes explicitly unavailable rather than granting acceptance when neither is usable. Health exposes active modes and never falls through on corruption, replay, schema, idempotency or ambiguous-write failures.

nodes.label: memory.release-outcomes
nodes.summary: Retains replay-validated, append-only and explicitly non-authorizing trusted-test, typed incident and unverified human-correction candidates linked to exact run/project/source and policy roots. Completion requires live PostgreSQL verification, HTTP/MCP exposure, signed/tamper-evident anchoring, historical-policy replay, decision/override/production kinds, prior-outcome retrieval integration and an adjudicated corpus.

nodes.label: governance.live-acceptance-evidence
nodes.summary: Defines a pinned fifteen-gate live campaign, strict signed receipt contracts, issuer-role separation, exact-byte append-only receipt storage, independently compiled expected-execution contracts and authenticated typed execution-assertion artifacts. The host-owned no-argument baseline service can compose only the fixed read-only LIVE_BASELINE phase; local obligations are either exactly verified from signed durable evidence or preserved as policy-pinned unresolved non-runtime deferrals, never converted into passes. Candidate-controlled Node test output is explicitly refused as receipt authority. The modules cannot self-authorize, keep requirements_satisfied and release_eligible false, and have no current live acceptance receipt.

nodes.label: tools.mcp
nodes.summary: Tools delegate to shared services and expose no scenario-specific endpoint.

nodes.label: runtime.salesforce-target-planning
nodes.summary: Derives a complete target obligation partition from the verified candidate and independently binds it to default-deny host policy. A closed, versioned source operation document declares variables, response projection, dataset ownership/cardinality, browser intent, changed-file disposition and local validation obligations; every admitted source is bound by exact relative locator, bytes and candidate tree digest. A host-pinned phase policy may mark only exact declared non-runtime checks as unresolved and not required for the fixed read-only LIVE_BASELINE gate set. It cannot erase them, execute Apex/browser/mutation targets, or waive candidate-check, deployment, restoration or release obligations. Unknown, runtime, consumed-contract, omitted, extra, wildcard, expired, production or caller-widened targets block. The plan grants no authority and no target has been executed live.

nodes.label: runtime.salesforce-live-evidence
nodes.summary: A host-owned no-argument service compiles the verified candidate, independently proves the active Salesforce access-token subject and non-production organization, seals a fixed SF-L03/SF-L04/SF-L05 read-only target set, resolves exact synthetic dataset membership, and executes bounded standard REST, source-contract custom REST and metadata reads. It validates the real Salesforce CLI status/result/statusCode/headers/body envelope, canonicalizes API versions, revalidates identity and expiry before dependent work, persists exact signed assertion/receipt bytes and replays cached evidence. FastAPI and MCP expose only bounded sanitized status and accept no caller alias, route, scope, receipt or campaign. Private host authority and phase-policy files remain unissued, candidate-controlled Node tests remain blocked for candidate phases, and no live receipt exists.

nodes.label: runtime.salesforce-candidate-deployment
nodes.summary: Planned exactly authorized non-production check-only, candidate deployment, mandatory restoration and zero-residue reconciliation use independently issued mutation and recovery permits. No current module, offline test or live receipt authorizes deployment or metadata mutation.

nodes.label: quality.live-test-execution
nodes.summary: Execution consumes selected obligations and configured runners.

nodes.label: automation.browser-worker
nodes.summary: A typed Playwright worker, fixed-alias CLI session broker and digest-pinned coordinator use one-shot in-memory session handoff, nonpersistent browser contexts, bounded DOM capture or non-mutating candidate readback, origin/identity checks, cleanup reporting and secret-safe process boundaries. The live-smoke command is diagnostic-only: it emits no signed campaign receipt, and even a diagnostic PASSED result cannot satisfy SF-L06, SF-L07 or SF-L09.

nodes.label: automation.applied-healing
nodes.summary: Disabled-by-default browser and metadata recovery boundaries consume a complete source-bound BrowserTarget contract, prove baseline and actual stale-locator failures, accept exactly one fresh semantic candidate per stale obligation, rerun every declared read-only assertion, and independently reconcile Salesforce metadata/residue, locator-state reset and local session closure. The headless probe never clicks, fills, submits, saves or persists raw locators. Unknown, ambiguous, partial, untrusted, stale, concurrent or leaking adapter results fail closed. Concrete signed production authority, cross-language dispatch and durable accepted receipts remain absent, so live execution stays disabled and no live healing claim exists.

nodes.label: REQ-SRC-001
nodes.summary: Capture a complete pinned Salesforce source change and its evidence graph without caller-narrowed scope.

nodes.label: REQ-RSN-001
nodes.summary: Produce source-neutral graph-grounded impact, context, proposals and test obligations with deterministic validation.

nodes.label: REQ-ORC-001
nodes.summary: Coordinate typed cooperating specialists with replayable observability and durable resumable memory.

nodes.label: REQ-SF-001
nodes.summary: From the configured org machine, independently classify a non-production Salesforce org with the host-pinned v1.1.0 display/Organization/userinfo-subject/active-User reconciliation sequence, repeat server subject and display before completion, authenticate locally without relying on preferred alias display, execute bounded MCP-backed standard and source-contract custom APIs, retrieve scoped metadata, run selected live tests, and complete an exactly authorized candidate deployment plus mandatory restoration campaign with phase-bound receipts.

nodes.label: REQ-UIA-001
nodes.summary: Establish an ephemeral authenticated Playwright session to the classified live Salesforce Lightning app, then capture, propose, authorize, apply and verify generic UI locator recovery while abstaining on ambiguity.

nodes.label: REQ-GOV-001
nodes.summary: Ground material claims, measure explicit populations and fail closed on incomplete release evidence.

nodes.label: REQ-UX-001
nodes.summary: Present a polished dashboard that distinguishes recorded evidence, proposals, execution and unavailable capabilities.
